title: acs phases registry (workflows/phases.yaml)
description: Every plugin skill grouped into exactly one of five phases, plus alias directories that forward to a registered skill and internal legs that map to the user-facing entry point they serve. acs_lib.workflow.load_phases additionally checks that no skill is listed twice across the phase lists, the alias keys and the internal keys, that every alias targets a registered skill, and that every internal leg has a skills/<dir> and points at a phase-listed skill that is not itself a leg.

aliases.description: {alias-dir: registered-skill}; the alias directory forwards to the skill.

agents.description: {skill: [role, ...]}; the subagent roles that skill owns, per ADR-0092. A skill declares the machinery its work needs -- nothing is inferred from whether it is hooked, and a skill omitted here owns no subagents at all. A planner appears only where planning and doing are genuinely separate work, which for a skill whose deliverable IS a plan or an analysis they are not.

internal.description: {internal-leg: entry-point}; the leg keeps its SKILL.md, agents, hooks and gate and stays Skill-invocable, but the entry point is the only user-facing command for it.
